display_long_description:
🚨 NO SIGNAL. NO CREW. NO WAY BACK

A catastrophic event has torn your spacecraft apart, leaving you adrift in deep space. You awaken alone inside the wreckage, surrounded by failing systems and a growing sense that something is deeply wrong.

[media]

To survive, you must explore the ship, adapt, and uncover the truth hidden within it.

🧩 Puzzles You Can Feel

Intuitive, hands-on puzzle solving designed for VR. Interact naturally with objects, tools, and ship systems as new mechanics are introduced step by step.

🌌 Explore in Low Gravity

Drift through a calm, haunting sci-fi world. Float, push, and guide yourself through the broken remains of your spacecraft and the mysterious spaces beyond.

[media]

⏱️ A Journey That Evolves

Interconnected areas reveal new tools, mechanics, and story pieces. Every discovery builds on what came before, deepening the mystery.

🧠 More Than Just Puzzles

AVO is a journey of adaptation, discovery, and atmosphere.

Discover how this world works
Follow your curiosity
Uncover what really happened

[media]

✨ Why You'll Enjoy AVO

- Designed for natural VR interaction
- 5 to 6 hours of gameplay
- Easy to begin, satisfying to master
- Atmospheric, cinematic, and deeply engaging

🌠 Step into the unknown. Just begin exploring, and let the experience unfold.
